columns: When an enemy damages you or you
dodge, leave a decoy behind. It attracts
nearby enemies for a limited time and
has its own cooldown.
Discovering a point of interest increases
vegetation growth. After you discover
several points of interest, receive a
random bonus.
Impacts from jaws, beak, leech, spit, and
projectile tongue attacks apply poison.
The poison deals ability damage once
per second.
